title: Миссис Панг возвращается в дом матери
alt: A Plump Married Woman Goes Back to Her Mother's Home / Mrs. Pang Visits Her Mother / Pangsao Hui Niangjia 胖嫂回娘家
description: When Mrs. Pang, who has just made a new dress for her sleeping baby, receives a letter telling her that her mother is seriously ill, she prepares to leave that very night but is so scatterbrained that she starts forgetting things.

en: When Mrs. Pang, who has just made a new dress for her sleeping baby, receives a letter telling her that her mother is seriously ill, she prepares to leave that very night but is so scatterbrained that she starts forgetting things.
